tools.name: list_offers
tools.when_to_use: See all supplier offers (one per account) for a product by its supplier_product_id.
tools.when_not_to_use: You just want the cheapest price (use get_best_offer), or product content/attributes (use the catalog service).

tools.name: get_best_offer
tools.when_to_use: Get the cheapest offer (lowest UAH price) for a product across all suppliers and accounts.
tools.when_not_to_use: You need the full list of offers (use list_offers).

tools.name: get_offer
tools.when_to_use: Fetch a single offer by its internal offer_id (ULID).
tools.when_not_to_use: You only have a product id (use list_offers).
